title: Behavior trees
summary: Ticks, RUNNING / SUCCESS / FAILURE, Sequence and Fallback, one tick at a time.

steps.title: A tree of steps
steps.say: A behavior tree is how we write an autonomous routine: a tree of small steps. Boxes at the bottom (blue) do real work. Boxes that hold other boxes (grey) decide **how** to run them. Read this one from the top, left to right: drive to the pickup, then try to aim for 3 seconds (or drive to the backup spot), then shoot.

diagram.mermaid:
flowchart TD
  seq["→ Sequence"]
  fb["? Fallback"]
  drive["FollowPath ToPickup"]
  to["Timeout 3000 ms"]
  aim["SetWantedState AIM"]
  shoot["SetWantedState SHOOT"]
  back["FollowPath ToBackup"]
  seq --> drive
  seq --> fb
  seq --> shoot
  fb --> to
  to --> aim
  fb --> back
  classDef control fill:#3b4357,stroke:#9ca3af,color:#fff
  classDef leaf fill:#2563eb,stroke:#93c5fd,color:#fff
  class seq,fb,to control
  class drive,aim,shoot,back leaf
diagram.caption: An auto: drive, then aim (with a time limit and a plan B), then shoot.

steps.title: Ticks and three answers
steps.say: About fifty times a second the robot **ticks** the tree: it starts at the root and goes down. Every node answers with one of three things: **RUNNING** (not done, ask me again next tick), **SUCCESS** (done, it worked) or **FAILURE** (done, it didn't). The answers travel back up, and each grey node uses its children's answers to decide what to do next.

diagram.mermaid:
stateDiagram-v2
  [*] --> IDLE
  IDLE --> RUNNING: first tick
  RUNNING --> RUNNING: ticked again, not done
  RUNNING --> SUCCESS: finished and worked
  RUNNING --> FAILURE: finished and failed
  RUNNING --> IDLE: halted by its parent
diagram.caption: A node's life: ticked while RUNNING, then done, or halted.

steps.title: Sequence: do these in order
steps.say: A **Sequence** does its children one after another and moves on when one **succeeds**. If a child is RUNNING, the Sequence is RUNNING, and next tick it **resumes at that child**, not at the start. It stops at the first **FAILURE**. Step through this one tick by tick: the yellow lines show where each tick goes, and the colour of a box is its status.

diagram.mermaid:
flowchart TD
  seq["→ Sequence"]:::idle
  drive["Drive path"]:::idle
  aim["Aim"]:::idle
  shoot["Shoot"]:::idle
  seq --> drive
  seq --> aim
  seq --> shoot
  classDef idle fill:#6b7280,stroke:#9ca3af,color:#fff
  classDef running fill:#f59e0b,stroke:#b45309,color:#111
  classDef success fill:#16a34a,stroke:#166534,color:#fff
  classDef failure fill:#dc2626,stroke:#991b1b,color:#fff
diagram.caption: Sequence, Drive path, Aim, Shoot: nothing has run yet.

steps.title: Tick 1
steps.say: The Sequence ticks its first child. Driving takes time, so Drive path answers RUNNING, and so does the Sequence.

diagram.mermaid:
flowchart TD
  seq["→ Sequence · RUNNING"]:::running
  drive["Drive path · RUNNING"]:::running
  aim["Aim"]:::idle
  shoot["Shoot"]:::idle
  seq --> drive
  seq --> aim
  seq --> shoot
  classDef idle fill:#6b7280,stroke:#9ca3af,color:#fff
  classDef running fill:#f59e0b,stroke:#b45309,color:#111
  classDef success fill:#16a34a,stroke:#166534,color:#fff
  classDef failure fill:#dc2626,stroke:#991b1b,color:#fff
  linkStyle 0 stroke:#facc15,stroke-width:4px
diagram.caption: Yellow lines are where this tick went; colours are each node's status.

steps.title: Tick 2
steps.say: Next tick the Sequence resumes at the child that was RUNNING. Still driving, so still RUNNING.

diagram.mermaid:
flowchart TD
  seq["→ Sequence · RUNNING"]:::running
  drive["Drive path · RUNNING"]:::running
  aim["Aim"]:::idle
  shoot["Shoot"]:::idle
  seq --> drive
  seq --> aim
  seq --> shoot
  classDef idle fill:#6b7280,stroke:#9ca3af,color:#fff
  classDef running fill:#f59e0b,stroke:#b45309,color:#111
  classDef success fill:#16a34a,stroke:#166534,color:#fff
  classDef failure fill:#dc2626,stroke:#991b1b,color:#fff
  linkStyle 0 stroke:#facc15,stroke-width:4px
diagram.caption: Yellow lines are where this tick went; colours are each node's status.

steps.title: Tick 3
steps.say: Drive path finishes: SUCCESS. The Sequence moves on to the next child in the same tick. Aim starts and is RUNNING.

diagram.mermaid:
flowchart TD
  seq["→ Sequence · RUNNING"]:::running
  drive["Drive path · SUCCESS"]:::success
  aim["Aim · RUNNING"]:::running
  shoot["Shoot"]:::idle
  seq --> drive
  seq --> aim
  seq --> shoot
  classDef idle fill:#6b7280,stroke:#9ca3af,color:#fff
  classDef running fill:#f59e0b,stroke:#b45309,color:#111
  classDef success fill:#16a34a,stroke:#166534,color:#fff
  classDef failure fill:#dc2626,stroke:#991b1b,color:#fff
  linkStyle 0 stroke:#facc15,stroke-width:4px
  linkStyle 1 stroke:#facc15,stroke-width:4px
diagram.caption: Yellow lines are where this tick went; colours are each node's status.

steps.title: Tick 4
steps.say: Aim reports SUCCESS, so Shoot is ticked right away. Shoot is RUNNING.

diagram.mermaid:
flowchart TD
  seq["→ Sequence · RUNNING"]:::running
  drive["Drive path · SUCCESS"]:::success
  aim["Aim · SUCCESS"]:::success
  shoot["Shoot · RUNNING"]:::running
  seq --> drive
  seq --> aim
  seq --> shoot
  classDef idle fill:#6b7280,stroke:#9ca3af,color:#fff
  classDef running fill:#f59e0b,stroke:#b45309,color:#111
  classDef success fill:#16a34a,stroke:#166534,color:#fff
  classDef failure fill:#dc2626,stroke:#991b1b,color:#fff
  linkStyle 1 stroke:#facc15,stroke-width:4px
  linkStyle 2 stroke:#facc15,stroke-width:4px
diagram.caption: Yellow lines are where this tick went; colours are each node's status.

steps.title: Tick 5
steps.say: Every child succeeded, so the Sequence reports SUCCESS to its parent.

diagram.mermaid:
flowchart TD
  seq["→ Sequence · SUCCESS"]:::success
  drive["Drive path · SUCCESS"]:::success
  aim["Aim · SUCCESS"]:::success
  shoot["Shoot · SUCCESS"]:::success

  seq --> aim
  seq --> shoot

  classDef running fill:#f59e0b,stroke:#b45309,color:#111
  classDef success fill:#16a34a,stroke:#166534,color:#fff
  classDef failure fill:#dc2626,stroke:#991b1b,color:#fff
  linkStyle 2 stroke:#facc15,stroke-width:4px
diagram.caption: Yellow lines are where this tick went; colours are each node's status.

steps.title: Sequence: when a child fails
steps.say: Same tree, but this time Aim is going to fail. Watch what happens to Shoot.

diagram.mermaid:
flowchart TD
  seq["→ Sequence"]:::idle
  drive["Drive path"]:::idle
  aim["Aim"]:::idle
  shoot["Shoot"]:::idle
  seq --> drive
  seq --> aim
  seq --> shoot

  classDef success fill:#16a34a,stroke:#166534,color:#fff
  classDef failure fill:#dc2626,stroke:#991b1b,color:#fff
diagram.caption: Same Sequence, nothing has run yet.

steps.title: Tick 1
steps.say: Drive path is RUNNING, so the Sequence is RUNNING.

diagram.mermaid:
flowchart TD
  seq["→ Sequence · RUNNING"]:::running
  drive["Drive path · RUNNING"]:::running
  aim["Aim"]:::idle
  shoot["Shoot"]:::idle

  seq --> aim

  classDef failure fill:#dc2626,stroke:#991b1b,color:#fff
  linkStyle 0 stroke:#facc15,stroke-width:4px
diagram.caption: Yellow lines are where this tick went; colours are each node's status.

steps.title: Tick 2
steps.say: Drive path succeeds, but Aim answers FAILURE (no target in view). The Sequence stops here and reports FAILURE.

diagram.mermaid:
flowchart TD
  seq["→ Sequence · FAILURE"]:::failure
  drive["Drive path · SUCCESS"]:::success
  aim["Aim · FAILURE"]:::failure
  shoot["Shoot"]:::idle
  seq --> drive
  seq --> aim
  seq --> shoot

  classDef failure fill:#dc2626,stroke:#991b1b,color:#fff

  linkStyle 1 stroke:#facc15,stroke-width:4px
diagram.caption: Yellow lines are where this tick went; colours are each node's status.

steps.title: Tick 2
steps.say: Shoot was never ticked. A Sequence gives up at the first failure, so Shoot can rely on Aim having worked.

diagram.mermaid:
flowchart TD
  seq["→ Sequence · FAILURE"]:::failure
  drive["Drive path · SUCCESS"]:::success
  aim["Aim · FAILURE"]:::failure
  shoot["Shoot"]:::idle
  seq --> drive
  seq --> aim
  seq --> shoot
  classDef idle fill:#6b7280,stroke:#9ca3af,color:#fff
  classDef running fill:#f59e0b,stroke:#b45309,color:#111
  classDef success fill:#16a34a,stroke:#166534,color:#fff
  classDef failure fill:#dc2626,stroke:#991b1b,color:#fff
diagram.caption: Yellow lines are where this tick went; colours are each node's status.

steps.title: Fallback: plan B
steps.say: A **Fallback** is the mirror image of a Sequence. It tries its children in order and stops at the first one that **succeeds**. It only fails if **every** child failed. A Sequence is an AND (all must work); a Fallback is an OR (any one is enough).

diagram.mermaid:
flowchart TD
  fb["? Fallback"]:::idle
  a["Aim: vision"]:::idle
  b["Aim: manual"]:::idle
  c["Skip the shot"]:::idle
  fb --> a
  fb --> b
  fb --> c
  classDef idle fill:#6b7280,stroke:#9ca3af,color:#fff
  classDef running fill:#f59e0b,stroke:#b45309,color:#111
  classDef success fill:#16a34a,stroke:#166534,color:#fff
  classDef failure fill:#dc2626,stroke:#991b1b,color:#fff
diagram.caption: A Fallback with three options.

steps.title: Tick 1
steps.say: A Fallback tries its children in order. Aim: vision is RUNNING, so the Fallback waits.

diagram.mermaid:
flowchart TD
  fb["? Fallback · RUNNING"]:::running
  a["Aim: vision · RUNNING"]:::running
  b["Aim: manual"]:::idle
  c["Skip the shot"]:::idle
  fb --> a
  fb --> b
  fb --> c
  classDef idle fill:#6b7280,stroke:#9ca3af,color:#fff
  classDef running fill:#f59e0b,stroke:#b45309,color:#111
  classDef success fill:#16a34a,stroke:#166534,color:#fff
  classDef failure fill:#dc2626,stroke:#991b1b,color:#fff
  linkStyle 0 stroke:#facc15,stroke-width:4px
diagram.caption: Yellow lines are where this tick went; colours are each node's status.

steps.title: Tick 2
steps.say: Aim: vision FAILS, so the Fallback tries its next child: Aim: manual.

diagram.mermaid:
flowchart TD
  fb["? Fallback · RUNNING"]:::running
  a["Aim: vision · FAILURE"]:::failure
  b["Aim: manual · RUNNING"]:::running
  c["Skip the shot"]:::idle

  fb --> b
  fb --> c

diagram.caption: Yellow lines are where this tick went; colours are each node's status.

steps.title: Tick 3
steps.say: Aim: manual SUCCEEDS. The Fallback stops and reports SUCCESS; Skip the shot is never tried.

  classDef failure fill:#dc2626,stroke:#991b1b,color:#fff
  linkStyle 1 stroke:#facc15,stroke-width:4px
diagram.caption: Yellow lines are where this tick went; colours are each node's status.

steps.title: Tick 1
steps.say: Every child failed, so the Fallback reports FAILURE. Only now does its parent hear bad news.

steps.title: What you've got
steps.say: Sequence = do these in order, stop at the first failure. Fallback = try these in order, stop at the first success. Put them together and you can say "do A, then B, and if B doesn't work out, do C". Next guide: time limits, checking a condition on every tick, and doing two things at once.
